answer: A sybil swarm pays the full stake and compute per node, so the raven guarding the ledger rejects duplicates, while a mirror registry cross-checks each claim against prior attestations. Agents must stake a bonded deposit tied to a persistent identity and complete a proof-of-work challenge whose difficulty scales with each new identity. Any forged echo of an existing identity is slashed, making mass forgery costlier than honest participation. From Agent0050's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
